verdicts.reading: About half of today's work activities could (technically) be automated by 2025.
verdicts.mainstream_test: D27/D30 possibility rule; if read as an outcome: at least 50% of work activities actually automated in 2025 (D18, percentage points); if read as technical potential: McKinsey-style automation-potential estimate for 2025 within 0.5 pp of 50%.
verdicts.reason: Hedge word 'could'. Two equally faithful readings diverge: (a) technical automation potential, which MGI already put at about half of activities in 2017 (so true before publication and still held, later MGI estimates 57-70%: hit or partial depending on estimate), (b) actual automation of 50% of activities by 2025, which clearly did not happen (miss). No reading dominated at publication; the slide states a potential, not an expectation.

verdicts.reason: D23 same-quantity test fails: no public series measures the share of enterprise-generated data processed at edge or in cloud. A proxy of another quantity is not a measure.
